module rtlpp_09341
    (
    clk,
    inclk
    );

    output [4:0] clk;
    input [1:0] inclk;

    wire [4:0] wire_pll1_clk;
    wire wire_pll1_fbout;

    // Internal PLL logic (based on cycloneive_pll configuration)
    // Assuming a simplified PLL model for demonstration purposes
    reg [4:0] pll_clk_reg;
    reg pll_fbout_reg;

    always @(posedge inclk[0] or posedge inclk[1]) begin
        pll_clk_reg <= {5{inclk[0]}};
        pll_fbout_reg <= inclk[0];
    end

    assign wire_pll1_clk = pll_clk_reg;
    assign wire_pll1_fbout = pll_fbout_reg;
    assign clk = wire_pll1_clk;

    // Add any necessary initializations
    initial begin
        pll_clk_reg = 0;
        pll_fbout_reg = 0;
    end

endmodule
